description: Read the current GA4 Data API property quota snapshot from the official v1alpha endpoint. This does not run a report, but Google still charges one property-quota token to the category with the most remaining quota.

propertyId.description: Numeric GA4 property ID or properties/{id}.

name: ga4_get_property_quotas_snapshot

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: ga4 get property quotas snapshot
